title: ONEBENCH to Test Them All: Sample-Level Benchmarking Over Open-Ended Capabilities

bias_targets.methodology: Consolidating individual evaluation datasets into a unified, ever-expanding sample pool and using a Plackett-Luce random utility model to aggregate model rankings, which mitigates dataset-specific systematic quirks and overfitting.
Enabling extensive sample reuse and dynamic querying across an open-ended pool of capabilities to avoid the selection bias inherent in choosing fixed, static tasks for multi-task benchmarks.
